title: Kirkpatrick: metallic orbs worldwide, said at NASA panel

tellings.quote: Kurt Patrick, former director of Aeros said uh quote, "We're seeing metallic orbs, direct quote, making very interesting apparent maneuvers all over the world."

plain: At a NASA panel in 2023 on UAP, the government's term for UFOs, Sean Kirkpatrick, who ran AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate such sightings, is quoted as saying: "We're seeing metallic orbs making very interesting apparent maneuvers all over the world." A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff quotes the line to Michels as an official's own words, in an episode about challenging the well-known UFO skeptic Mick West to a debate. If it stands, the head of the office whose job was to explain sightings was himself saying unexplained objects were turning up worldwide.
